text: {"lessons":["Selling winners quickly can feel satisfying, but I should avoid letting the pleasure of locking in gains dictate my decisions; reassess each holding on its prospects.","Buying more shares does not erase a bad entry. I should review whether each position still merits its place rather than defend it because I dislike admitting a mistake.","After several periods of losses and no trades, I should check my portfolio regularly and make deliberate decisions based on current information, not simply avoid acting because selling at a loss hurts."]}
